messages:
Maya Patel: quick note — webinar registrations are getting stuck waiting for enrichment. we lose the 1st-touch window.
Chris Nguyen: propose immediate RR to 'event-sdr' with partial_profile=true and owner_preserve=true. SLA target for accept = 8m.
Olivia Chen: implement via webhook flag fast_path=true and header x-rollout=canary. enrichment will PATCH profile fields only; it must not reassign owner unless owner==null.
Jordan Lee: add observability events: lead.routed.fast_path, lead.accept.ms, lead.enrich.latency. alert if median accept > 480000ms or accept_rate < 70%.
Samir Khan: SF connector change: upsert with preserve_owner=true. also add a unit test to ensure ownership isn't overwritten.
lead-bot: webhook canary smoke OK (200). sample: {"email":"test@company.com","campaign":"q2-webinar","fast_path":"true","x-rollout":"canary"}
Maya Patel: fallback: if no accept in 8m -> escalate to overflow queue and post note "auto-escalated after 8m no-accept".
Chris Nguyen: canary plan: start 5% registrations, watch 60m. if green ramp to 25% after 2h.
Olivia Chen: SDR playbook snippet: when profile is partial -> confirm email/title, use script A, log "partial-profile" tag. training doc in Confluence.
Maya Patel: ship canary by Friday EOD. :rocket:
